cards.text: Picture it, friend: it's winter in Jerusalem, and the Feast of Dedication is going on. Jesus, the Lamb Himself, is walking in the temple courts, in Solomon’s Colonnade. Winter, baker. Even my ovens would be asking for a scarf.
Then the Jews gather around Jesus and demand, “How long will You keep us in suspense?” That's me staring at those three little typing dots in a group chat, yelling JUST SEND IT.

cards.question: The crowd around Jesus wants a straight answer. What do they ask Him to tell them plainly?

answers.text: Whether He is John the Baptist

cards.text: Jesus says He already told them, but they did not believe. And He says there's something that speaks up for Him.

cards.question: Jesus says something testifies on His behalf. What is it?

answers.text: The works He does in His Father’s name
The crowds who follow Him everywhere
The priests who serve in the temple

cards.question: Jesus talks to the crowd about His sheep. True or false: He says these people refuse to believe because they are not His sheep.
Jesus says His sheep listen to His voice. He knows them, and they ___ Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He gives His sheep eternal life, and they will never perish. Friend, I got lost in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS, so that word “never” hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus is talking about His sheep and how safe they are. True or false: He says someone strong enough could snatch them out of His Father’s hand.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “I and the Father are one.” Six words, baker. Hold on to your apron.

cards.question: Jesus has just said He and the Father are one. What do the Jews do at this?

answers.text: They pick up stones to stone Him
They bow down and worship Him
They turn and walk away from Him

cards.text: With stones in their hands, Jesus tells them He has shown them many good works from the Father. Me? Somebody picks up a stone, I'm hopping this gold base clear across the planet before they let go.

cards.question: Jesus reminds the crowd of His many good works from the Father. What does He ask them?

answers.text: Which of these they are stoning Him for
Why they came to the feast this year
Who sent them to the temple courts

cards.question: The Jews say they're not stoning Jesus for any good work. What do they say it's for?

cards.text: They say He's a man making Himself out to be God. Jesus answers with Scripture: “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?”

cards.question: Jesus points to the ones called gods, the ones the word of God came to. True or false: In the same breath, He says the Scripture cannot be broken.
Jesus talks about the One the Father sanctified and sent into the world. How can they accuse Him of blasphemy, He asks, for saying He is who?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.” That's like me saying, if my cookies come out burnt, don't eat them, except He's got nothing burnt to worry about.

cards.question: But if He is doing the works, Jesus says, then even if they don't believe Him, they should believe the ___ themselves.
Jesus tells the crowd the Father is in Him, and He is in the Father. True or false: At this, they finally seize Him and hold on to Him.

cards.text: Jesus escapes their grasp, then goes back across the Jordan and stays there. Me? I can't even escape a pile of chocolate chips, and I dove in on PURPOSE.

cards.question: The place across the Jordan where Jesus stays is where somebody had first been baptizing. Who?

cards.text: Many people come to Jesus there. And they start talking about John, the man who had been baptizing in that very spot.

cards.question: The people across the Jordan are talking about John. True or false: They say John performed many signs.
The people say everything John said about Jesus was ___.
Stones in Jerusalem, but what happens with many people in that place across the Jordan?

answers.text: Many there try to seize Him
Many there tell Him to leave
